description: This file contains tests for inline evaluation detection in various command-line argument scenarios, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: detectInterpreterInlineEvalArgv
methods.description: Detects if the provided argument vector corresponds to a command that performs inline code evaluation or execution.

methods.name: describeInterpreterInlineEval
methods.description: Provides a string description of the inline eval pattern detected for reporting.

methods.name: isInterpreterLikeAllowlistPattern
methods.description: Checks if a given filename or path matches known patterns of interpreter-like executables.
